description.text: Teaching Objectives The major trains enroll students to produce quality engineers of computer software and hardware in design, development and applications. By study, students can master the fundamental theories and basic techniques of computer software and hardware; eligible to analysis, design and develop software; eligible to use, develop and maintain hardware; eligible to operate and maintain computer networks.InternshipCognition Practice, Social Investigation/Study-abroad Program, Integrated Course Desig, Corporation Internship, Graduate Project (Thesis).Degree AwardedBachelor of Engineering Degree

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at LiaoNing Petrochemical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1666 USD/per year ￥ 12000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.2. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated intoChinese or English and be notarized.3. Academic transcript of high school4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning)With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included.For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper.5. requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent.2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
